description: Germany only. German employment law, Germany only: checks shifts against the rules on breaks (Pausen), maximum daily and weekly working time (Höchstarbeitszeit) and rest between shifts (Ruhezeit) under the ArbZG, or the stricter JArbSchG for employees under 18. Returns working time, required and actual break per day, rest period and each violation. Use it to check a shift plan or a time sheet.

branche_10_stunden_ruhezeit.description: Industry that may shorten rest to 10 hours: hospital, care, restaurants, transport, broadcasting, agriculture (§ 5 Abs. 2 ArbZG)

tage.description: Shifts in order, one per day

datum.description: Date of the shift, optional, needed for Sundays and totals per calendar week (YYYY-MM-DD)

vortag_ende.description: End of the last shift on the day before the first day, optional (HH:MM, 24 h)

name: pausen
title: Pausen und Ruhezeit
